notes.title: A fresh ship out of the gates!
notes.content:
More streamlined than the angular original, the new Thalion is a good option if you value manouverability over heavy armour. Check out the stages of design, from concept to 3D model through to the final textured version.

notes.title: Updated Drone Model!
notes.content:
If you were able to experience Hyper Hadron Racing at Play Expo Blackpool last year you may already be familiar with these tricky little bots which will pursue and harass if you fly too near. For everyone else, here is a close look at the drones complete with their rotating "gun head" and antenna ears!
